kills.property: For any caller and any bytes32 hash and any msg.value, the reference contract only accepts a lockInGuess call when exactly 1 ether is sent (calls with other values revert); the mutant removes this check and therefore accepts calls with msg.value != 1 ether.
kills.change_summary: Remove the requirement that msg.value equals 1 ether, allowing calls with different msg.value to set the guess and block.

kills.property: For any caller with no prior guess, calling lockInGuess with exactly 1 ether succeeds (reference requires guesses[msg.sender].block == 0), whereas the mutant inverts that guard and will reject first-time callers (fuzzer can find an address with no prior guess causing the mutant to revert while reference accepts).
kills.change_summary: Change the initial require that ensures no existing guess to instead require that a guess already exists (inverting the guard), preventing new guesses but allowing overwrite only when one exists.
